Population increased in Ashfield

The estimated population of Ashfield in 2024 was 129,572 usual residents, a rise of 0.9% since 2023.

This meant that Ashfield's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Ashfield increased by 2.5%.

Over this slightly longer period, Ashfield was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Ashfield

The average (median) age fell to 42.1 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Ashfield has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Ashfield is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Ashfield's population of 129,572 usual residents was made up of:

  • 23,900 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.4%)
  • 79,686 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.5%)
  • 25,986 people aged 65 years and over, (20.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Ashfield has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (61.5% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Ashfield, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Ashfield
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Ashfield, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 247 people (-0.2%). In total, there were 1,212 births and 1,459 deaths in Ashfield.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 761 (0.6%). There were 7,290 people entering the area and 6,529 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Ashfield's population of 614 (0.5%) as a result of 829 people entering the area and 215 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Ashfield was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Ashfield in mid-2023 is 128,449.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 211 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 122 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 89 people.
